test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In November 2021 at Zonal Council Meet, Chief Minister N Rangaswamy made the statement regarding which union territory upgrading the status of the Union Territory is critical to its survival.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Puducherry.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **In November 2021 at Zonal Council Meet, Chief Minister N Rangaswamy made the statement regarding Puducherry upgrading the status of the Union Territory is critical to its survival.**
 
• Union Minister of Home Affairs and Minister of Cooperation, Shri Amit Shah will chair the 29th meeting of the Southern Zonal Council comprising the States of Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Telangana, and Union Territories of Puducherry, Lakshadweep, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Zonal Councils are the statutory (and not constitutional) bodies.
 
• They are established by an Act of the Parliament, that is, the States Reorganisation Act of 1956
 
• The act divided the country into five zones- Northern, Central, Eastern, Western and Southern and provided a zonal council for each zone.
